one_liner: Pinterest API v5 is a broad REST API with OAuth 2.0 and no fees, but new apps need Trial approval and a Standard-access review (demo video) for real use; the MCP server is announced, though the pages don't confirm it has launched.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with app ID and secret is the main path. Access tokens last 30 days and refresh is supported. Once Trial is approved, 24-hour product-limited test tokens can be generated without OAuth. These are for exploration only, so API_KEY is listed as secondary.
access_notes: No API fee is published. A business account must submit an app request for Trial access, and Pinterest reviews it and emails a decision. Trial Pins and Boards are visible only to their creator, and rate limits are lower. Standard access requires a video demo of the OAuth flow. The pages give no review turnaround time.
blocker_notes: Trial approval is required first, then a Standard-access review with a demo video before real multi-user use. Trial content is sandboxed to its creator.

evidence.quote: Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest. You will receive an email notification after your app has been reviewed, letting you know whether it was approved or denied access.
